The design covers Axxium login and Bearer/session verification, fresh capability input combined with Knoxx tenant/resource policy, browser cookie state, existing-user migration without re-registration, and eventual retirement of standalone Knoxx authentication modules/storage. It is grounded in accepted Axxium `2439d4d6` and independently inspected Knoxx `3409977b`, retaining the current approved coexistence protections.

The complete proposed contract includes an Axxium-owned versioned status/introspection deliverable with distinct authentication rejection401, authenticated insufficient grant403 and retryable fail-closed unknown/unavailable evidence503. The verification matrix now separately requires service-caller authentication at a fixed operator-configured HTTPS authority: missing/invalid service credentials refuse independently of actor credentials, and caller-controlled authority/issuer/URL overrides refuse before untrusted network contact or protected effects. Cutover epochs and authenticated account-change watermarks govern Axxium-authority-preserving rollback, changed-credential invalidation and continuity for existing and post-cutover users. All method, trust, service-authentication, freshness and recovery decisions require review before implementation.
